coaching.headline: A 30-minute objective stranglehold — neutrals 24-14, towers 10-3, +22 VP.
coaching.team: This wasn't a fight win, it was a map win: we took the neutrals 24-14 and snowballed it into a 10-3 tower lead. Cuban's Sparrow gave us the carry to cash those leads in (16/1/1), and our anti-heal was on point — four Tainted items buried their Riktor at 0/5/6 so their one healer never mattered. The lever is that this was a clean five-stack executing the right win condition: keep playing for objectives off won fights instead of chasing kills.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Even in a win, build the resist the matchup demands — Xeebs' Khaimera ran zero magic resist into a 3-magical enemy comp, and against a sharper team that's a free death window.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow hard-carried at 16/1/1 — Cuban Noobster's at every checkpoint vs Revenant, one death all game and 35k hero damage. Even with the Vanquisher spike not landing until ~25m, the lane was won outright before then; this win keyed off Cuban.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Khaimera jungle, 7/5/12 — Xeebs' at every checkpoint vs Boris. Xeebs won it on play; just buy magic resist into their 3-magical comp next time, because that's the one thing that could have opened a death window in the late fights.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Iggy & Scorch, 4/1/7 and 40k into objectives — even early then Goldilocks324's late vs Aurora, and the Wraith Leggings spike ~25m lined up with that takeover. That zone control is exactly why every neutral fell our way.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: The Fey mid, 2/1/14 with a single death — the Gadget lane was even early and tipped Mr_Meat31's way late, right around the Wraith Leggings spike (~19m). The peel and 14 assists let the carry farm kills safely.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Steel support, 0/4/19 — Willy Guggenheim's read vs Riktor was ours all game, and he mitigated 48282 as the frontline. Pure enabling, and the Tainted item helped shut their Riktor down.

threats: Chain-CC risk (4 hard-CC abilities, ~3.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Riktor. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
ourKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
ourKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
ourKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
ourKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

ourKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
ourKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
ourKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

Loadout Eternal Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as Sparrow kills minions and monsters. Generic farming scaling, not tied to any ability. (game text: Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.) Field: 49% in 574 games, 3% of picks, below the hero-role's 50%.

Loadout minor Iron Will: Basic attacks heal for a small share of their damage, double on critical hits. Better once she builds critical chance. (game text: Restore Health equal to 3% of Basic Attack damage dealt, increased to 6% for Critical Strikes.) Field: 46% in 278 games, 48% of picks, below the hero-role's 50%.

Loadout minor Bone Collector: After killing 150 units she permanently gains 20% critical chance. That boosts her basic attacks and Inner Fire, whose arrows can already critically strike. A farming reward for her late game. (game text: After killing 150 units, permanently gain 20% Critical Chance.) Field: 50.4% in 383 games, 67% of picks, level the hero-role's 50%.

Loadout crest Pacifier: Dash and empower her next hit, which hits much harder on low-health targets and can be recast after a kill. Use it to finish someone softened by Piercing Shot. (game text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.) Field: 52.8% in 6008 games, 34% of picks, above the hero-role's 50%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds, Demolisher, Iron Will.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Demolisher, Pacifier. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
The Eternal was part of it: Xyris (Iron Will + Bone Collector) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 4 players Sparrow killed built physical armor (Riktor, Aurora). Anti-heal on Riktor, Boris. We killed Sparrow 1 time.

Copy it? Xyris (Iron Will + Bone Collector): 46.4% in 235 Sparrow carry games, below the hero's 50%; this 3-item core: 55.3% in 972 games, level with the 55.2% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
